panels.title: Order-flow recording coverage — snapshots/hour per pair (live)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS v FROM trades WHERE env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(100.0*AVG((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int),1) AS v FROM trades WHERE env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(SUM(pnl_net_usdt)::numeric,2) AS v FROM trades WHERE env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN pnl_net_usdt>0 THEN pnl_net_usdt ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(-SUM(CASE WHEN pnl_net_usdt<0 THEN pnl_net_usdt ELSE 0 END),0))::numeric,2) AS v FROM trades WHERE env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pnl_net_usdt)::numeric,4) AS v FROM trades WHERE env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(DISTINCT pair) AS v FROM trades WHERE env='dev'

SELECT to_timestamp(exit_ts/1000.0) AS "time", SUM(pnl_net_usdt) OVER (ORDER BY exit_ts) AS cumulative_net_usdt FROM trades WHERE env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY exit_ts

panels.title: Cumulative net PnL (equity curve, all archived trades)

targets.rawSql: SELECT split_part(bot_id,'-',4) AS strategy, count(*) AS trades, ROUND(100.0*AVG((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int),1) AS win_pct, ROUND(SUM(pnl_net_usdt)::numeric,2) AS net_usdt, ROUND(AVG(pnl_net_usdt)::numeric,4) AS avg_usdt, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN pnl_net_usdt>0 THEN pnl_net_usdt ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(-SUM(CASE WHEN pnl_net_usdt<0 THEN pnl_net_usdt ELSE 0 END),0))::numeric,2) AS pf FROM trades WHERE env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_usdt ASC

SELECT pair, count(*) AS trades, ROUND(100.0*AVG((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int),1) AS win_pct, ROUND(SUM(pnl_net_usdt)::numeric,2) AS net_usdt, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN pnl_net_usdt>0 THEN pnl_net_usdt ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(-SUM(CASE WHEN pnl_net_usdt<0 THEN pnl_net_usdt ELSE 0 END),0))::numeric,2) AS pf FROM trades WHERE env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_usdt ASC
SELECT close_reason, count(*) AS n FROM trades WHERE env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL AND close_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
SELECT pnl_net_usdt FROM trades WHERE env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL

SELECT close_reason, count(*) AS n, ROUND(100.0*AVG((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int),1) AS win_pct, ROUND(SUM(pnl_net_usdt)::numeric,2) AS net_usdt FROM trades WHERE env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL AND close_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_usdt ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN floor(((entry_ts/1000) % 86400) / 3600.0) < 8 THEN 'ASIAN' WHEN floor(((entry_ts/1000) % 86400) / 3600.0) < 13 THEN 'LONDON' WHEN floor(((entry_ts/1000) % 86400) / 3600.0) < 16 THEN 'OVERLAP' WHEN floor(((entry_ts/1000) % 86400) / 3600.0) < 21 THEN 'US' ELSE 'LATE' END AS session, count(*) AS trades, ROUND(100.0*AVG((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int),1) AS win_pct, ROUND(AVG(pnl_net_usdt)::numeric,4) AS avg_usdt FROM trades WHERE env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_usdt DESC

SELECT s.regime, count(*) AS trades, ROUND(100.0*AVG((t.pnl_net_usdt>0)::int),1) AS win_pct, ROUND(SUM(t.pnl_net_usdt)::numeric,2) AS net_usdt FROM trades t JOIN signals s ON s.trade_id=t.id WHERE t.env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL AND s.regime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_usdt ASC

panels.title: Signal Funnel — where signals die before firing (archive events)

targets.rawSql: SELECT split_part(split_part(message,':',2),':',1) AS reject_reason, count(*) AS n FROM events WHERE message LIKE 'signal_rejected:%' OR message LIKE 'risk_rejected:%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT CASE WHEN message LIKE 'signal_rejected:%' THEN 'rejected (pipeline)' WHEN message LIKE 'risk_rejected:%' THEN 'rejected (risk)' WHEN message LIKE 'signal_fired%' OR message LIKE 'order_%' THEN 'fired' ELSE 'other' END AS outcome, count(*) AS n FROM events WHERE category IN ('signal','risk','order') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC

panels.title: Order-Flow / Microstructure — depth imbalance & the alignment-gate thesis (archive)

targets.rawSql: WITH j AS (  SELECT t.direction, t.pnl_net_usdt, (    SELECT m.depth_imb5 FROM microstructure m     WHERE m.pair=t.pair AND m.ts BETWEEN t.entry_ts-30000 AND t.entry_ts+30000     ORDER BY abs(m.ts-t.entry_ts) LIMIT 1) AS imb   FROM trades t WHERE t.env='dev' AND exit_ts IS NOT NULL AND pnl_net_usdt IS NOT NULL) SELECT CASE WHEN imb IS NULL THEN 'no order-flow coverage'   WHEN (direction='long' AND imb>0) OR (direction='short' AND imb<0) THEN 'flow-ALIGNED'   ELSE 'flow-AGAINST' END AS bucket, count(*) AS trades, ROUND(100.0*AVG((pnl_net_usdt>0)::int),1) AS win_pct, ROUND(AVG(pnl_net_usdt)::numeric,4) AS avg_usdt, ROUND(SUM(pnl_net_usdt)::numeric,2) AS net_usdt FROM j GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY win_pct DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: ★ Gate thesis: trade win% by order-flow ALIGNMENT at entry (depth_imb5 nearest snapshot ≤30s; signed by direction)

targets.rawSql: SELECT depth_imb5 FROM microstructure WHERE depth_imb5 IS NOT NULL
SELECT spread_bps FROM microstructure WHERE spread_bps IS NOT NULL AND spread_bps<20

SELECT pair, count(*) AS snapshots, ROUND(AVG(spread_bps)::numeric,3) AS avg_spread_bps, ROUND(AVG(depth_imb5)::numeric,4) AS avg_depth_imb5, ROUND(STDDEV(depth_imb5)::numeric,3) AS sd_imb5 FROM microstructure GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY snapshots DESC
